parts.tooltip: fmap f :: IO a ⟶ IO (IO b)\nA recipe that runs ma and returns f a — a new recipe — without running it.

join :: IO (IO b) ⟶ IO b — the IO-specific part
A recipe that, when run by the runtime:
1. runs the outer recipe to obtain the inner recipe
2. runs the inner recipe
Order of effects = order of binds.

ports.tooltip: IO a — a description of a side-effectful computation. Nothing runs yet.
f : a ⟶ IO b — user code; given the result of running ma, returns the next IO action
IO b — the composed recipe. Effects of ma happen before effects of f(a). Never IO (IO b).
